title: Obstructions to coarse universality for finitely generated groups
summary: We prove that, for every bounded-degree graph $Λ$ admitting a finitely cobounded coarse quasi-action by a group, there is a finitely generated group which does not coarsely embed into $Λ$. More generally, for every countable family $(Λ_i)$ of such graphs, there is a finitely generated group that does not coarsely embed into any $Λ_i$. This resolves two conjectures of Simon Thomas: neither a universal Cayley graph nor a universal quasi-isometry class of finitely generated groups exists.
